draft_key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue decreased 2.6% to EUR 765.3 million (from EUR 785.8 million in 2024), with core route operations down EUR 13.7 million to EUR 625.2 million; EBITDA declined to EUR 130.1 million (from EUR 175.2 million); net profit fell to EUR 17.3 million (from EUR 40.3 million) with earnings per share at EUR 0.02 (from EUR 0.05).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: Key Figures table and 'Earnings' section detailing revenue, EBITDA, net profit, and EPS for 2025 vs 2024.

draft_key_information_units.information: Passenger volumes decreased 0.9% to 5.5 million (from 5.58 million in 2024); cargo units transported fell 19.2% to 245,004 (from 303,234); passenger vehicles carried declined 2.2% to 760,473 (from 777,592).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Key Figures' table and operational summary stating passenger, cargo, and vehicle volumes for 2025 vs 2024.

draft_key_information_units.information: Key performance drivers included weak consumer and business confidence, geopolitical tensions impacting demand; fleet optimization through vessel sales and continued chartering; cost efficiency measures; and a depreciation expense decline from aligning cruise/passenger vessel useful lives to 45 years (excluding shuttle vessels).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The following operational factors impacted...' section and 'Earnings' section detailing depreciation impact and strategic focus on cost efficiencies.

draft_key_information_units.information: Fleet management involved the sale of three vessels (passenger vessel Star I in April, cargo vessels Regal Star in August and Sailor in October) and reduction of lay-up vessels from four to zero by Q3 2025; three vessels (Romantika, Galaxy I, Silja Europa) remained chartered out at year-end.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: Bullet points under operational factors listing vessel sales, lay-up reductions, and chartering details.

draft_key_information_units.information: Segment performance: Estonia-Finland route revenue increased EUR 1.7 million to EUR 314.5 million (passenger volumes up 1.8%) while Finland-Sweden routes declined EUR 3.3 million to EUR 225.5 million (due to maintenance) and Estonia-Sweden routes fell EUR 12.1 million to EUR 85.3 million (passenger volumes down 12.5%).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Sales and Segments' section breaking down revenue and results by route, including passenger/cargo unit changes and maintenance impacts.

draft_key_information_units.information: Net debt decreased to EUR 432.4 million (from EUR 537.7 million in 2024) with a net debt/EBITDA ratio of 3.3 (vs 3.1 in 2024); cash position impacted by EUR 44.6 million dividends paid (plus EUR 11.3 million related income tax) and EUR 113.5 million in loan repayments and interest during the year.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Liquidity and Cash Flow' section detailing net debt, dividend payments, and financing activities.

draft_key_information_units.information: Capital investments totaled EUR 33.0 million (focused on vessel maintenance and IT systems), with planned maintenance and repair works amounting to 73 vessel-days.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Liquidity and Cash Flow' and 'Investments and Vessels' sections specifying capital expenditures and maintenance days.

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic focus on emissions reduction includes preparations to transition shuttle vessels (MyStar and Megastar) to liquified biomethane from 2026, targeting a 75% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions and cost mitigation amid regulatory pressures.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO Letter to Shareholders and Sustainability Strategy and Governance section outlining biofuel transition plans and environmental targets.

draft_key_information_units.information: Post-reporting-period management changes: Paavo Nõgene resigned as Chairman of the Management Board effective May 2026; Peep Jalakas appointed as new Chairman effective April 2026; Margus Schults removed from Management Board effective February 2026 (remaining as Managing Director of Tallink Silja Oy).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 25: 'Subsequent Events' and Management Report 'Events After the Reporting Period' detailing management board resignations and elections.

evaluation.selection_rationale: The units prioritize headline financial performance (D1), major period-over-period volume changes (D2), explicitly stated performance drivers including economic factors, fleet actions, and cost/depreciation effects (D3), material fleet developments (D4), key segment variances (D5), liquidity and capital position (D6-D7), and important strategic/post-period events (D8-D9). Routine boilerplate (governance, remuneration, risk lists, accounting policies) is excluded. Each unit represents an independently omittable theme supported by the SOURCE, with reference_support indicating alignment with the REFERENCE SUMMARY's salience focus. The selection covers all prioritized areas: financials, changes, drivers, segments, liquidity, operations, and post-period events, while maintaining conciseness (9 units).
